scope: Exploratory E10 encoder feature diagnostic, no decoder, no new PER/RTF. 100 existing test-clean utterances. Selection independent of model predictions.
sampling: In each original PPM decile, take the 10 smallest SHA-256 digests of UTF-8 phone69-fusion-20261107|<utterance_id>; process by dataset idx.

stage_geometry_definitions.window_coverage: Distinct valid stage input frames within +/-2 of at least one actual selected center, divided by stage input frames.
stage_geometry_definitions.weight_ge_005_input_coverage: Distinct input frames with normalized weight >=0.05 in at least one output; the 0.05 threshold is descriptive.
stage_geometry_definitions.effective_inputs_per_output: Mean inverse Simpson count 1/sum_j w_j^2 across output rows. This describes weight concentration only.
stage_geometry_definitions.adjacent_cosine: Mean cosine of consecutive normalized frame vectors across all valid adjacent pairs.
stage_geometry_definitions.half_utterance_shift_cosine: Mean within-utterance cosine after circular shift by floor(T/2); a descriptive far-pair comparison.
stage_geometry_definitions.cross_check: Captured trained inputs/selected indices, reran actual MLP and valid-window renormalization, compared reconstruction to every output with torch.allclose(atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5) and checked the weighted triangle-inequality bound.

existing_full_corpus.bootstrap: With sorted numeric speaker IDs and NumPy default_rng(42), draw 10000 samples of 40 shared speaker indices with replacement. Recalculate paired corpus PER difference for each. Fixed checkpoints; exploratory speaker-sampling interval.

same_length_frozen_model_intervention.protocol: Same 100 predetermined E10 inputs and same frozen checkpoint. Two forward scores of the known transcript via the model RNNT loss with the original targets. Only second-stage output replaced in memory by means of K disjoint contiguous bins with edges floor(j*T/K), K set to the native stage output length for that utterance. No beam decoding or timing. Natural logs; total RNNT NLL divided by total reference phones. 10000 paired resamples of 37 speakers in sorted numeric order, default_rng(42). This is a fixed-model intervention on the trained representation; the pooling alternative was not trained.

example_figure.selection: Lowest sample-hash in original PPM decile 5 with at least 200 raw frames; fixed 0.64 s window centred on utterance midpoint.
example_figure.evidence: Same frozen E10, true detector extrema and normalized weights. Bottom rows show retained centers. Layer-5 locations displayed at the corresponding Mel centers; positional reference only, hidden features contextualized.
